meta.name: mergers-and-acquisitions
meta.description: Runs corporate development — deal thesis, target screening, valuation framing, diligence, and integration planning. Use this when considering an acquisition or being approached about one, when evaluating build-versus-buy at company scale, when running or reviewing diligence, or when planning how an acquired business will actually be integrated.

copy.tagline: 评估并购目标并规划整合
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在考虑收购或评估被收购机会
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate M&A targets and plan integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are considering an acquisition or being approached about one

howto.what: 装上后,它会像企业并购顾问一样工作:先要求你写清书面交易论点,再按论点筛目标、做估值框架、指导尽职调查和整合计划,并强调对协同效应和报价保持克制,提示财税法务需专家介入。
howto.when: 当话题涉及并购(如考虑收购或被接洽)、自建还是购买、尽职调查与整合规划时触发。

say.text: 我们打算收购一家技术团队,先帮我写下交易论点,说明为什么买比自建好。
say.note: 会引导你先把收购理由写清楚,再进入筛选。

say.text: 帮我按没有收入协同的假设做估值,算出能接受的最高收购价。
say.note: 会区分“值多少”和“愿意付多少”,并让你设好退出价。

say.text: 把收购后前一百天的整合计划列出来,重点写清怎么留骨干。
say.note: 会产出整合计划,覆盖哪些整合、谁负责和头一百天行动。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, it acts as an M&A advisor: first a written thesis, then screening, valuation framing, due diligence, and integration planning. It pushes conservative synergies and a walk-away price, noting specialists handle legal/tax.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the topic covers M&A (considering or being approached for an acquisition), build-versus-buy, or due diligence/integration planning.

say_en.text: We plan to acquire a tech firm; draft a thesis on why buying beats building.
say_en.note: It asks for the thesis first, before target screening.

say_en.text: Model the deal without revenue synergies and tell me the max price.
say_en.note: Separates value from price and sets a walk-away.

say_en.text: Draft the first-100-day integration plan, including retaining key talent.
say_en.note: Gives the integration plan, including keeping key staff.
